22  
  
GLIC017 Eohilia (budesonide suspension) 
 
APPLICABLE AGENT(S): 
Eohilia 
 
See Banner Medicaid FFS Criteria for initial approval. 
 
CRITERIA FOR RENEWAL: 
Documentation of positive clinical response to Eohilia therapy as evidenced by 
improvement or full resolution to EoE symptoms along with a reduction in 
intraepithelial eosinophils per high power field (HPF) 
 
LENGTH OF AUTHORIZATION 
12 months
